text: An honest finding only matters once it becomes a rule someone can actually follow -- that's what this video writes down.
The hybrid decision rule: classical stays the default for real decisions until a quantum result proves repeatable agreement at real scale.
The noise-modeled simulation stage, run before any real hardware, is no longer optional -- it's standard practice now.
What the team will recommend next, and what it won't: keep testing, don't move real decisions onto QAOA yet.
Next: writing the technical report and the reproducibility package anyone could rerun.
